svg.title: Clessidra faceplate, Synthux Simple Touch
svg.desc: 1:1, pt. Black plate, art in white, grey and orange (UV print over black mask). Outline and opening centres from Synthux's Simple Touch Faceplate template (DXF), the outline as its lines and arcs (R 48.48 shoulder, R 3.31 corners). Screw drills unknown: holes drawn 2.3 mm, to confirm.
